Name: Cooking Anywhere
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[center][b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]✨Cooking Anywhere✨[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]Cooking Anywhere lets you turn any tile into a cooking spot with Tile Marker. Face a marked tile and press your normal action button to open the same cooking flow used by a regular kitchen.
[/center]
[left][center][b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]SMAPI[/center]
[/left]
[center]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer[/center]
[center]Tile Marker 1.1.0 or newer
[/center]
[center][color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]How to use[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center]Open Tile Marker using the key configured for it.Choose Cooking spots or any other location you wish to mark as a cooking spot .Mark the tiles you want to use and save. Face one of those tiles and press the game's normal action button.[/center]
[center]You can mark tiles in any location available to your save. The marks are stored by Tile Marker.
[/center]
[center][b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]So far, I haven't had any issues with the other mods installed in my game. If you encounter any incompatibilities, please let me know.[/center]
[left][url=https://github.com/SheilaEXE/Cooking-Anywhere/blob/main/README.md#compatibility][/url][/left]
